title: Capstone: Ship a Reusable Agent Workbench Pack — Testing the Pack on New Repositories
titleKn: ಕ್ಯಾಪ್‌ಸ್ಟೋನ್: ಮರುಬಳಕೆ Agent Workbench ಪ್ಯಾಕ್ — ಹೊಸ ರೆಪೊಗಳಲ್ಲಿ Pack ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ
desc: A pack is only reusable if it installs cleanly on repositories it was not built for.
objectives: Install the pack on two unfamiliar repositories.
Fix assumptions that only held for the first one.
objectivesKn: ಮೊದಲ ರೆಪೊಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಊಹೆ ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಿ.

title: Capstone: Ship a Reusable Agent Workbench Pack — Releasing and Maintaining
titleKn: ಕ್ಯಾಪ್‌ಸ್ಟೋನ್: ಮರುಬಳಕೆ Agent Workbench ಪ್ಯಾಕ್ — ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ
desc: Version the pack, write release notes and set up a way to collect improvements from users.
objectives: Version the pack with a changelog.
Collect feedback and evidence of benefit.
